name: Stonegate Plaza Simi Valley Shopping Center
demographics: Stonegate Plaza serves the Simi Valley community, which is characterized by middle-class families and working professionals with moderate to above-average household incomes. The trade area attracts a diverse mix of residents seeking convenient neighborhood services, from young families utilizing childcare and fitness facilities to established households requiring professional services like dental and legal care. Shopping patterns reflect a preference for practical, service-oriented businesses rather than destination retail, with visitors typically making quick trips for specific needs like dining, personal care, and professional appointments.
description: Stonegate Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located at 5702-5786 East Los Angeles Avenue in beautiful Simi Valley, California. This convenient strip center offers an eclectic variety of shops and services designed to meet the everyday needs of the local community. The plaza features a diverse tenant mix including popular dining options like Ling's Imperial Chinese Restaurant, personal care services such as Jen's Nails spa, and essential professional services including dental care and legal offices. With ample parking and a friendly atmosphere, Stonegate Plaza has established itself as a go-to destination for Simi Valley residents seeking quality services in a comfortable, accessible setting. The center's commitment to providing a wide range of offerings from fitness to restaurants makes it a versatile community hub that serves multiple needs in one convenient location.
summary: Stonegate Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in Simi Valley offering an eclectic mix of restaurants, personal care services, fitness facilities, and professional services. With ample parking and convenient access, it serves as a practical community destination for everyday needs.
